content.content:
== Four Months for a Boat (completed)
- Never-Sold, who keeps the Chainbreakers' house in Blackrose, asked me to end an eleven-year Owing on the Tulm-Varo estate. She gave me a leaf of her own writing to put in the count-box in place of the real one, five picks from her own store, and the Owing's first price, 100 gold. I'm to speak to Rows-For-Another on the channel bank north of the town.
- Rows-For-Another told me the three things that hold her. Her leaf is in the keeper's count-box inside the estate house on the farm, and the keeper, Hulm-Tei, carries its key. His word could close the Owing. Brings-Them-Back, the estate's fetcher, watches the channel north of the bank. I'm to end her Owing by any of the three.
- I killed Brings-Them-Back on the channel. Nobody living knows the way to Rows-For-Another's home tree now. I'm to tell her the channel is clear, unless I end it another way first.
- I told Rows-For-Another the channel is clear. She will go by it once I have gone, and she gave me a word for Never-Sold. I'm to tell Never-Sold she is going.
- I told Never-Sold that Rows-For-Another has gone by the channel. Brings-Them-Back is dead, so nobody can follow her home. Never-Sold paid me in full and named me one of the Chainbreakers, and did not thank me for how. She said to come back to her for more work.

content.content:
== Four Months for a Boat (completed)
- Never-Sold, who keeps the Chainbreakers' house in Blackrose, asked me to end an eleven-year Owing on the Tulm-Varo estate. She gave me a leaf of her own writing to put in the count-box in place of the real one, five picks from her own store, and the Owing's first price, 100 gold. I'm to speak to Rows-For-Another on the channel bank north of the town.
- Rows-For-Another told me the three things that hold her. Her leaf is in the keeper's count-box inside the estate house on the farm, and the keeper, Hulm-Tei, carries its key. His word could close the Owing. Brings-Them-Back, the estate's fetcher, watches the channel north of the bank. I'm to end her Owing by any of the three.
- I killed Brings-Them-Back on the channel. Nobody living knows the way to Rows-For-Another's home tree now. I'm to tell her the channel is clear, unless I end it another way first.
- I told Rows-For-Another the channel is clear. She will go by it once I have gone, and she gave me a word for Never-Sold. I'm to tell Never-Sold she is going.
- I told Never-Sold that Rows-For-Another has gone by the channel. Brings-Them-Back is dead, so nobody can follow her home. Never-Sold paid me in full and named me one of the Chainbreakers, and did not thank me for how. She said to come back to her for more work.
== One Out of the Smoke (completed)
- Never-Sold sent me to the heirs' post on Blackrose's east shore. Three people the Rose holds are kept there, and one can be got out. She wants the one held for words, and she will not pay to loose a stranger she cannot name. I'm to speak to the keeper of the post.
- Tsaxi told me he can count one of the three lost to the smoke, and no more. One of the two younger held killed a man, and the leaves that say which are with the Rose's reckoner, who never came in from the western swamp. I'm to learn who is who, if I can, and get one of them out.
- I took the singed leaves from the reckoner's strongbox in his tent in the western swamp. They name each of the three, why they are held, and their home tree. I'm to bring them to Tsaxi, or tell one of the three to go without his leave.
- I gave Tsaxi the reckoner's leaves and told him his camp was empty but for a lamia. He kept them. The count is his now, and he will say one died of the smoke. I'm to tell the one I choose to go.
- I told Walks-Far to go when I had gone. The other two stay. I'm to tell Never-Sold.
- I told Never-Sold that Walks-Far came out, and that Mends-Nets and Seven-Floods stayed. She was pleased, and uneasy, and paid me 150 gold, and said to come back to her for more work.
